card.financial_crisis_lifeline.text: Payroll clears tomorrow. The account does not. Before you can call anyone, the Mentor's office calls you: a private bridge loan, *no paperwork until later.*
ending.ending_bankrupt.title: THE OFFICE CLOSES
ending.ending_bankrupt.text: The final payments leave in the morning. By noon, staff carry boxes past the cameras. Only then do you understand that politics leaves no room for innocence about the price of each choice. You failed to keep the doors open. Your term ends there.
